# Watering Interval

Watering intervals are day values on the reference planter, and each plant profile
carries its own setting.

## Answer

The documentation and an independent practitioner write-up agree that the interval is
set in days rather than weeks (CL-001), and the planter stores the interval per plant
profile rather than globally (CL-003).
